summary: This Form 8-K reports JAB Acquisition Corp I’s closing of its initial public offering (IPO) of 17,250,000 units at $10.00/unit, including the full over-allotment, generating $172.5 million in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 260,000 private units at $10.00/unit for $2.6 million. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share, one redeemable warrant (exercisable at $11.50/share), and one right to receive one-fourth of a Class A share upon a business combination. No additional sponsor units were sold on over-allotment exercise. The filing includes audited balance sheet reflecting the proceeds. As a blank-check SPAC, the company now has two years to complete an initial business combination or liquidate the trust, with the sponsor’s units providing downside protection. Watch for target announcement and shareholder vote dynamics.
